description: ISO 9362 BIC syntax and ISO 3166 country-code checks. No bank directory is bundled. With `reference_path` (or the PAYMENT_INTELLIGENCE_REFERENCE_PATH setting), also looks the BIC up in the user's own BIC Directory, Payments Directory, BIC Plus or other provider export: name, location, current or expired, successor BIC, and service participation. A directory record does not prove reachability for a specific payment; never use it alone for routing or compliance decisions.

as_of.description: Date for current or expired, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

reference_path.description: Optional: the user's reference data, read locally. An unzipped SWIFTRef BIC Directory or Payments Directory folder, one of its files, a legacy SWIFTRef product file (BIC Plus, Bank Directory Plus, ...), or a CSV/TSV export from any provider.

name: check_bic
title: Check BIC syntax
